Definition: from G5442; a watcher or sentry:--keeper.
BiblicalUsage: Phylax is a keeper, a sentry on watch. The keepers stand before the prison doors in Acts 12:6 while Peter sleeps between two soldiers, and in Acts 12:19 Herod examines those same keepers and puts them to death when the prisoner is gone.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that men can guard a door all night and still lose what God has set free.
